lines.trans: Here is the goods, as you ordered, chef.
Open the box and show me the caviar.
This is excellent pike caviar, five kilograms.
It looks very beautiful and appetizing.
The price is only two hundred rubles per kilogram.
This is indeed a very cheap price.
We saved the restaurant a lot of money.
But the color of this caviar is too yellow.
Pike caviar is always yellow in color.
And the guests expect expensive black caviar.
What are we to do with this color?
I have got a clever plan.
I am ready to help you in this business.

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
I grew up in a communal flat.
They will give only eight years.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)

examples.text: Двести десять на сто тридцать девять!
examples.trans: Two hundred and ten over one hundred and thirty-nine!

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: Щучья икра имеет яркий жёлтый цвет.
examples.trans: Pike roe has a bright yellow color.

meanings.note: красная икра = red (salmon) caviar, чёрная икра = black caviar
как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Give me two kilograms of apples, please.
We were putting it into boxes.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun
a door, window, bottle, or business

examples.trans: I'm going to open it now.

meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up

examples.text: Пусть только ещё раз здесь появится!

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!

examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

сохранить.gloss: to keep, to preserve, to save

meanings.note: сохранить тайну = to keep a secret

examples.text: А ты мою тайну вчера сохранил?
